plugin.note: Dragonbane melee is the default recommendation, with ranged and water-spell magic as valid alternatives. Use Protect from Missiles and dragonfire protection or dodge volcanic breath; Guardian Drake needs movement from its melee stun special.

requirements: 84 Slayer to damage Drakes or receive the task
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Recommended high combat stats: 80+ melee stats, 75+ Ranged, or 85+ Magic depending on style
Recommended prayers: Piety for melee, Deadeye/Rigour for ranged, Mystic Vigour/Augury for magic
Bigger and Badder unlock for Guardian Drake superior spawns
mechanics: Drakes use ranged, ranged melee, and volcanic breath dragonfire.
Protect from Missiles fully blocks normal ranged attacks.
Drakes do not require dragonfire protection to be killed, but dragonfire protection reduces or negates volcanic breath.
After seven auto-attacks, Drakes launch volcanic breath at the player's current tile.
Volcanic breath deals four quick hits for 6-8 damage each if the player is struck without protection.
Move one tile away when the projectile is launched to completely avoid volcanic breath.
Dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or anti-dragon shield plus antifire negates volcanic breath damage.
Super antifire or extended super antifire also negates volcanic breath and allows defender or blowpipe setups.
Protect from Missiles plus dragonfire protection can make distant kills no-damage.
Drakes are draconic and weak to dragonbane weapons.
Drakes take 50% more damage from water spells.
Guardian Drake has the same volcanic breath when out of melee distance and a melee-distance stun special that hits through prayer.

methods.label: Requirements and transport
methods.summary: Prepare heat-protection footwear unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete, then travel to Mount Karuulm.
steps: Wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary burn immunity is unlocked.
Travel with Mount Karuulm teleport from Rada's blessing 3 or 4 when available.
Alternatively use fairy ring CIR, Battlefront Teleport, Skills necklace to Farming Guild, or Farming cape to the Farming Guild.
Use 29 or 62 Agility volcano shortcuts if not using Rada's blessing 3 or higher.
notes: Drakes are only found in the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon.

methods.label: Mechanics and dragonfire
methods.summary: Block normal ranged attacks with Protect from Missiles and handle volcanic breath by protection or movement.
steps: Keep Protect from Missiles active to fully block normal ranged attacks.
Count or watch for volcanic breath after seven auto-attacks.
When volcanic breath is launched, move one tile away from the targeted tile to completely avoid it.
Use one layer of dragonfire protection to reduce the special attack.
Use shield or ward protection plus antifire, or super antifire, to negate volcanic breath damage.
Attack from at least one tile away with Protect from Missiles and dragonfire protection for no-damage kills.
risks: Two-handed weapons, defenders, and blowpipe setups require either movement or super antifire to avoid all volcanic breath damage.
Without protection or movement, volcanic breath hits four times.

methods.label: Melee
methods.summary: Use dragonbane melee where possible; stab weapons perform well against Drake's low stab defence.
recommendedFor: Players using strong melee stats and Piety
steps: Use Dragon hunter lance as the top melee weapon when available.
Use stab-style alternatives such as Osmumten's fang, Ghrazi rapier, Blade of saeldor, Noxious halberd, or Zamorakian hasta.
Keep Protect from Missiles active against normal ranged attacks.
Use antifire protection or step away from volcanic breath when using a defender or two-handed weapon.
Use a cannon in the task-only area to speed kills slightly.
risks: If using a defender or two-handed melee weapon, volcanic breath must be dodged or covered by antifire protection.

methods.label: Ranged
methods.summary: Use Dragon hunter crossbow or strong ranged alternatives; shield setups can simplify volcanic breath protection.
recommendedFor: Players preferring distance and shield protection
steps: Use Dragon hunter crossbow when available.
Pair crossbows with dragonfire ward or anti-dragon shield if you do not want to dodge volcanic breath.
Use toxic blowpipe as an alternative only with super antifire or consistent volcanic breath dodging.
Use Hunters' sunlight crossbow, Bow of faerdhinen, Zaryte crossbow, Armadyl crossbow, or other crossbows as fallback options.
Keep Protect from Missiles active.
notes: The task page notes that off-task blowpipe setups only marginally improve DPS over cheaper Hunters' sunlight crossbow with Void.

methods.label: Magic water spells
methods.summary: Use Dragon hunter wand or water-spell setups to exploit Drake's 50% water weakness.
steps: Use Dragon hunter wand for a dragonbane magic setup.
Use water spells, Tome of water, or water-spell-compatible staves to exploit the 50% water weakness.
Use Ancient wyvern shield or anti-dragon shield if not relying on movement or super antifire.
Carry water, wrath, fire, and nature runes where using the listed rune pouch setup.
Keep Protect from Missiles active while attacking from distance.
risks: Two-handed magic setups must dodge volcanic breath or use antifire protection.

methods.label: Guardian Drake
methods.summary: Handle Guardian Drake by reacting to its melee-distance stun special and choosing range/flinch approaches when needed.
recommendedFor: Players with Bigger and Badder enabled
steps: Expect the regular volcanic breath special when you are not in melee distance.
If in melee distance, watch for yellow gaps on the Guardian Drake's back lighting up.
When the yellow warning appears, step out of melee distance quickly to avoid the stun special.
Use ranged weapons or flinching if you want to reduce exposure to the melee-distance stun.
Do not rely on prayer to block the stun special because it hits through prayer.
risks: Guardian Drake melee special can stun and hit over 30 damage through prayer.
The volcanic breath special still requires movement or dragonfire protection when fought at range.

methods.label: Melee inventory
methods.summary: Melee inventory uses dragonbane/stab gear, cannon, antifire, prayers, alchemy runes, bone handling, and herb sack.
inventory: Dragon claws or other special weapon
Divine rune pouch with Fire and Nature runes for High Alchemy and Dust and Law runes for Teleport to House

methods.label: Ranged inventory
methods.summary: Ranged inventory uses antifire, ranged boost, prayer potions, cannon, emergency food, and utility items.
inventory: Toxic blowpipe substitute if using super antifire or dodging volcanic breath

methods.label: Magic inventory
methods.summary: Magic inventory uses antifire, magic boost, rune pouch, utility items, prayer potions, food, bonecrusher, and herb sack.
inventory: Nature, Fire, Water, and Wrath runes

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter lance and stab melee setup for task kills.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter crossbow and ranged alternatives, with shield options for volcanic breath protection.

styleOptions.label: Magic water spells
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter wand and water-spell setups using Drake's 50% water weakness.

body:
# Drakes

Task-page strategy covering requirements and transport, volcanic breath and dragonfire handling, melee dragonbane, ranged dragonbane, magic water-spell setups, Guardian Drake superior handling, and style-specific inventories.
